operations.raw_sql:
with months as (
        select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 0 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 1 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 2 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 3 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 4 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 5 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 6 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 7 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 8 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 9 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 10 month as month_start
        union all select (curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month as month_start
),
mb as (
        select
            month_start,
            last_day(month_start) as month_end,
            timestamp(month_start) as from_dt,
            timestamp(last_day(month_start), '23:59:59') as to_dt
        from months
),
qc_types as (
        select name from `tabTask Type` where locate('QC', name) > 0
),
sa_desig as (
        select distinct designation
        from `tabDesignation Details`
        where parenttype = 'Incentive Calculation Setttings'
          and parentfield = 'service_advisor_designation'
          and designation is not null and designation != ''
),
qc_desig as (
        select distinct designation
        from `tabDesignation Details`
        where parenttype = 'Incentive Calculation Setttings'
          and parentfield = 'quality_controller_designation'
          and designation is not null and designation != ''
),
bse_desig as (
        select distinct designation
        from `tabDesignation Details`
        where parenttype = 'Incentive Calculation Setttings'
          and parentfield = 'bodyshop_estimator_designation'
          and designation is not null and designation != ''
),
ibd_desig as (
        select distinct designation
        from `tabDesignation Details`
        where parenttype = 'Incentive Calculation Setttings'
          and parentfield = 'insurance_bd_designation'
          and designation is not null and designation != ''
),
emp_info as (
        select
            name, employee_name, company, designation, status, is_technician,
            user_id, vehicle_workshop, vehicle_workshop_division
        from `tabEmployee`
),
targets as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            tr.sales_person,
            tr.employee,
            tr.designation,
            case month(mb.month_start)
                when 1 then trd.january when 2 then trd.february when 3 then trd.march
                when 4 then trd.april when 5 then trd.may when 6 then trd.june
                when 7 then trd.july when 8 then trd.august when 9 then trd.september
                when 10 then trd.october when 11 then trd.november else trd.december
            end as target_amount
        from `tabTarget Role Details` trd
        inner join `tabTarget Role` tr on tr.name = trd.parent
        inner join mb on trd.year = year(mb.month_start)
        where trd.parenttype = 'Target Role'
          and trd.parentfield = 'targets'
),
ts_lines as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            ts.employee,
            coalesce(task.reports_to, '') as reports_to,
            coalesce(task.job_controller, '') as job_controller,
            p.name as project,
            case when qt.name is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_qc,
            coalesce(tsd.hours, 0) as actual_time,
            coalesce(p.sold_time, 0) as project_sold_time,
            coalesce(p.actual_time, 0) as project_actual_time,
            coalesce(task.expected_time, 0) as task_expected_time,
            coalesce(task.actual_time, 0) as task_actual_time
        from `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
        inner join `tabTimesheet` ts on ts.name = tsd.parent
        inner join `tabTask` task on task.name = tsd.task
        left join `tabProject` p on p.name = task.project
        left join qc_types qt on qt.name = task.task_type
        inner join mb on mb.month_start = date(tsd.from_time) - interval (day(tsd.from_time) - 1) day
        where ts.docstatus < 2
          and task.vehicle_workshop is not null
          and task.vehicle_workshop != ''
          and tsd.from_time >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
),
ts_facts as (
        select
            l.month_start,
            l.employee,
            l.reports_to,
            l.job_controller,
            l.project,
            l.is_qc,
            l.actual_time,
            case when l.project_actual_time <> 0 then l.actual_time / l.project_actual_time else 0 end
                as project_time_portion,
            l.project_sold_time * coalesce(
                nullif(case when l.project_actual_time <> 0 then l.actual_time / l.project_actual_time else 0 end, 0),
                1.0
            ) as sold_time,
            l.task_expected_time * coalesce(
                nullif(case when l.task_actual_time <> 0 then l.actual_time / l.task_actual_time else 0 end, 0),
                1.0
            ) as expected_time
        from ts_lines l
),
grain as (
        select
            month_start, employee, reports_to, job_controller, project, is_qc,
            sum(actual_time) as actual_time,
            sum(sold_time) as sold_time,
            sum(project_time_portion) as no_of_repair_orders
        from ts_facts
        group by month_start, employee, reports_to, job_controller, project, is_qc
),
ts_emp_month as (
        select distinct
            date(tsd.from_time) - interval (day(tsd.from_time) - 1) day as month_start,
            ts.employee
        from `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
        inner join `tabTimesheet` ts on ts.name = tsd.parent
        where ts.docstatus < 2
          and tsd.from_time >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
),
att_raw as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            a.employee,
            coalesce(a.reports_to, '') as reports_to,
            coalesce(a.job_controller, '') as job_controller,
            case when coalesce(a.working_hours, 0) = 0 and a.attendance_date = curdate()
                 then coalesce(a.standard_working_hours, 0) else coalesce(a.working_hours, 0) end as w_hours,
            case when coalesce(a.working_hours, 0) = 0 and a.attendance_date = curdate()
                 then coalesce(a.standard_available_hours, 0) else coalesce(a.available_hours, 0) end as av_hours,
            coalesce(a.standard_working_hours, 0) as std_w_hours
        from `tabAttendance` a
        inner join emp_info emp on emp.name = a.employee
        inner join mb on a.attendance_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        left join ts_emp_month tem on tem.month_start = mb.month_start and tem.employee = a.employee
        where a.docstatus = 1
          and a.status in ('Present', 'Half Day')
          and a.attendance_date <= curdate()
          and a.attendance_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
          and (emp.is_technician = 1 or tem.employee is not null)
),
att_facts as (
        select
            month_start, employee, reports_to, job_controller,
            sum(av_hours) as available_hours,
            sum(greatest(0, w_hours - std_w_hours)) as out_of_shift_hours
        from att_raw
        group by month_start, employee, reports_to, job_controller
),
grp_types as (
        select 'emp' as grp_type union all select 'rt' union all select 'jc'
),
ts_by_all as (
        select
            t.grp_type,
            g.month_start,
            case t.grp_type when 'emp' then g.employee when 'rt' then g.reports_to
                 else g.job_controller end as grp,
            sum(g.actual_time) as actual_time,
            sum(g.sold_time) as sold_time,
            sum(g.no_of_repair_orders) as no_of_repair_orders,
            count(distinct case when g.is_qc = 1 then g.project end) as qc_ro_count,
            count(distinct case when g.is_qc = 0 then g.project end) as non_qc_ro_count
        from grain g
        cross join grp_types t
        group by t.grp_type, g.month_start, grp
),
att_by_all as (
        select
            t.grp_type,
            a.month_start,
            case t.grp_type when 'emp' then a.employee when 'rt' then a.reports_to
                 else a.job_controller end as grp,
            sum(a.available_hours) as available_hours,
            sum(a.out_of_shift_hours) as out_of_shift_hours
        from att_facts a
        cross join grp_types t
        group by t.grp_type, a.month_start, grp
),
prod_all as (
        select
            grp_type, month_start, grp,
            sum(actual_time) as actual_time,
            sum(sold_time) as sold_time,
            sum(no_of_repair_orders) as no_of_repair_orders,
            sum(qc_ro_count) as qc_ro_count,
            sum(non_qc_ro_count) as non_qc_ro_count,
            sum(available_hours) as available_hours,
            sum(out_of_shift_hours) as out_of_shift_hours
        from (
            select grp_type, month_start, grp, actual_time, sold_time, no_of_repair_orders,
                   qc_ro_count, non_qc_ro_count, 0 as available_hours, 0 as out_of_shift_hours
            from ts_by_all
            union all
            select grp_type, month_start, grp, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, available_hours, out_of_shift_hours
            from att_by_all
        ) u
        group by grp_type, month_start, grp
),
tl_cfb as (
        select
            month_start, reports_to,
            count(distinct project) as ro_count,
            round(avg(rating), 2) as avg_rating
        from (
            select distinct
                mb.month_start, task.reports_to, task.project,
                cf.overall_satisfaction_rating as rating
            from `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
            inner join `tabTimesheet` ts on ts.name = tsd.parent
            inner join `tabTask` task on task.name = tsd.task
            inner join `tabCustomer Feedback` cf on cf.project = task.project
            inner join mb on mb.month_start = date(tsd.from_time) - interval (day(tsd.from_time) - 1) day
            where cf.status = 'Completed'
              and task.reports_to is not null and task.reports_to != ''
              and ts.docstatus < 2
              and tsd.from_time >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        ) x
        group by month_start, reports_to
),
jc_wip as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            p.job_controller,
            count(p.name) as ro_count,
            round(avg(datediff(mb.month_end, date(p.project_date))), 2) as average_wip_age
        from `tabProject` p
        inner join mb on p.project_date <= mb.month_end
        where p.status != 'Cancelled'
          and p.project_status != 'Completed'
          and p.job_controller is not null and p.job_controller != ''
        group by mb.month_start, p.job_controller
),
jc_k2k as (
        select
            month_start,
            job_controller,
            truncate(avg(case when division = 'Body Shop' then age end), 0) as bodyshop_days,
            truncate(avg(case when division = 'Mechanical' then age end), 0) as mechanical_days
        from (
            select
                mb.month_start,
                p.job_controller,
                p.vehicle_workshop_division as division,
                coalesce(datediff(p.vehicle_delivered_date, p.vehicle_received_date), 0) as age
            from `tabProject` p
            inner join mb on p.vehicle_received_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
            where p.status != 'Cancelled'
              and p.job_controller is not null and p.job_controller != ''
              and p.vehicle_received_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
              and exists (
                  select 1 from `tabVehicle Service Receipt` vsr
                  where vsr.project = p.name and vsr.docstatus = 1
              )
        ) x
        group by month_start, job_controller
),
prod_rows as (
        select
            p.grp_type,
            p.month_start,
            p.grp,
            p.actual_time,
            p.sold_time,
            p.available_hours,
            p.out_of_shift_hours,
            p.qc_ro_count,
            p.non_qc_ro_count,
            e.employee_name, e.company, e.vehicle_workshop, e.vehicle_workshop_division,
            c.avg_rating,
            c.ro_count as ro_count_cfb,
            w.ro_count as wip_ro_count,
            w.average_wip_age as wip_average_age,
            k.bodyshop_days,
            k.mechanical_days,
            case when round(p.available_hours, 2) <> 0
                 then p.actual_time / p.available_hours * 100 else 0 end as per_productivity,
            case when round(p.actual_time, 2) <> 0
                 then p.sold_time / p.actual_time * 100 else 0 end as per_efficiency,
            case when round(p.available_hours, 2) <> 0
                 then p.sold_time / p.available_hours * 100 else 0 end as per_proficiency,
            case when p.sold_time <> 0 and p.available_hours <> 0
                 then round(p.sold_time / p.available_hours * 100, 3) else 0 end as sold_hrs_percentage,
            case when (p.qc_ro_count + p.non_qc_ro_count) <> 0
                 then round(p.qc_ro_count / (p.qc_ro_count + p.non_qc_ro_count) * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as total_qc_ro_percentage,
            case when p.grp_type = 'jc' and p.available_hours <> 0
                 then round((p.available_hours - p.actual_time - p.out_of_shift_hours)
                            / p.available_hours * 100, 3) end as total_idle_percentage
        from prod_all p
        inner join emp_info e on e.name = p.grp
        left join tl_cfb c on p.grp_type = 'rt'
            and c.month_start = p.month_start and c.reports_to = p.grp
        left join jc_wip w on p.grp_type = 'jc'
            and w.month_start = p.month_start and w.job_controller = p.grp
        left join jc_k2k k on p.grp_type = 'jc'
            and k.month_start = p.month_start and k.job_controller = p.grp
        where p.grp != ''
),
sa_sales as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            p.service_advisor as sales_person,
            sum(sii.base_net_amount) as total_sales_amount
        from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        inner join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent
        inner join `tabProject` p on p.name = sii.project
        inner join mb on si.posting_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        where si.docstatus = 1
          and p.service_advisor is not null and p.service_advisor != ''
          and si.posting_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        group by mb.month_start, p.service_advisor
),
sa_cfb as (
        select
            month_start, service_advisor,
            count(distinct project) as ro_count,
            round(avg(rating), 2) as avg_rating
        from (
            select distinct
                mb.month_start, p.service_advisor, p.name as project,
                cf.overall_satisfaction_rating as rating
            from `tabSales Invoice` si
            inner join `tabSales Invoice Item` sii on sii.parent = si.name
            inner join `tabProject` p on p.name = sii.project
            inner join `tabCustomer Feedback` cf on cf.project = p.name
            inner join mb on si.posting_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
            where cf.status = 'Completed'
              and p.service_advisor is not null and p.service_advisor != ''
              and si.docstatus = 1
              and si.posting_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        ) x
        group by month_start, service_advisor
),
sa_wip as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            p.service_advisor,
            count(p.name) as ro_count,
            round(avg(datediff(mb.month_end, date(p.project_date))), 2) as average_wip_age
        from `tabProject` p
        inner join mb on p.project_date <= mb.month_end
        where p.status != 'Cancelled'
          and p.project_status != 'Completed'
          and p.service_advisor is not null and p.service_advisor != ''
        group by mb.month_start, p.service_advisor
),
sa_allowed as (
        select sp.name as sales_person
        from `tabSales Person` sp
        inner join emp_info emp on emp.user_id = sp.user_id
        inner join sa_desig d on d.designation = emp.designation
        where sp.is_service_advisor = 1 and sp.enabled = 1
),
sa_rows as (
        select
            s.month_start,
            s.sales_person,
            coalesce(sp.sales_person_name, s.sales_person) as sales_person_name,
            emp.company,
            emp.vehicle_workshop,
            emp.vehicle_workshop_division,
            s.total_sales_amount,
            coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) as target_revenue,
            case when coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) <> 0
                 then round(s.total_sales_amount / t.target_amount * 100, 3) else 0 end as revenue_percentage,
            c.avg_rating,
            c.ro_count as ro_count_cfb,
            w.ro_count as wip_ro_count,
            w.average_wip_age as wip_average_age
        from sa_sales s
        left join `tabSales Person` sp on sp.name = s.sales_person
        left join emp_info emp on emp.user_id = sp.user_id
        left join targets t on t.month_start = s.month_start and t.sales_person = s.sales_person
        left join sa_cfb c on c.month_start = s.month_start and c.service_advisor = s.sales_person
        left join sa_wip w on w.month_start = s.month_start and w.service_advisor = s.sales_person
        where (select count(*) from sa_desig) = 0
           or s.sales_person in (select sales_person from sa_allowed)
),
qc_techs as (
        select emp.name as employee, emp.employee_name, emp.company,
            emp.vehicle_workshop, emp.vehicle_workshop_division
        from emp_info emp
        inner join qc_desig d on d.designation = emp.designation
        where emp.status = 'Active' and emp.is_technician = 1
),
qc_project_tasks as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            t.assigned_to as employee,
            p.name as project,
            max(case when qt.name is not null then 1 else 0 end) as has_qc,
            max(case when qt.name is not null
                      and p.billing_status not in ('Not Applicable', 'Not Billed')
                     then 1 else 0 end) as has_qc_invoiced,
            max(case when p.project_type = 'Comeback' then 1 else 0 end) as is_comeback
        from `tabProject` p
        inner join `tabTask` t on t.project = p.name
        inner join qc_techs qe on qe.employee = t.assigned_to
        inner join mb on p.project_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        left join qc_types qt on qt.name = t.task_type
        where p.project_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        group by mb.month_start, t.assigned_to, p.name
),
qc_counts as (
        select
            month_start, employee,
            count(*) as total_ro_count,
            sum(has_qc) as total_qc_ro_count,
            sum(case when has_qc = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as total_ro_count_non_qc,
            sum(has_qc_invoiced) as total_qc_invoice_ro_count,
            sum(is_comeback) as total_comeback_ro_count
        from qc_project_tasks
        group by month_start, employee
),
qc_cfb as (
        select
            month_start, assigned_to,
            count(distinct project) as ro_count,
            round(avg(rating), 2) as avg_rating
        from (
            select distinct
                mb.month_start, task.assigned_to, task.project,
                cf.overall_satisfaction_rating as rating
            from `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
            inner join `tabTimesheet` ts on ts.name = tsd.parent
            inner join `tabTask` task on task.name = tsd.task
            inner join emp_info te on te.name = task.assigned_to
            inner join `tabProject` tp on tp.name = task.project
            inner join `tabCustomer Feedback` cf on cf.project = task.project
            inner join mb on tp.project_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
            where te.status = 'Active'
              and te.designation = 'Quality Controller'
              and tp.project_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        ) x
        group by month_start, assigned_to
),
qc_rows as (
        select
            n.*,
            e.employee_name, e.company, e.vehicle_workshop, e.vehicle_workshop_division,
            c.avg_rating,
            c.ro_count as ro_count_cfb,
            case when n.total_qc_ro_count <> 0
                 then round(n.total_qc_invoice_ro_count / n.total_qc_ro_count * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as qc_invoiced_ro_percentage,
            case when n.total_ro_count <> 0
                 then round(n.total_comeback_ro_count / n.total_ro_count * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as comeback_ro_percentage,
            case when n.total_ro_count <> 0
                 then round(n.total_qc_ro_count / n.total_ro_count * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as total_qc_ro_percentage
        from qc_counts n
        inner join qc_techs e on e.employee = n.employee
        left join qc_cfb c on c.month_start = n.month_start and c.assigned_to = n.employee
),
est_invoiced as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            q.estimator_id as employee,
            sum(si.base_net_total) as total_sales_amount,
            count(distinct p.name) as total_ro_count
        from `tabQuotation` q
        inner join `tabProject` p on p.name = q.project
        inner join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.project = p.name
        inner join mb on si.posting_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        where si.docstatus = 1 and q.docstatus = 1
          and q.estimator_id is not null and q.estimator_id != ''
          and si.posting_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        group by mb.month_start, q.estimator_id
),
est_gross_profit as (
        select
            month_start, employee,
            sum(project_sales) as gp_sales,
            sum(project_margin) as gp_margin
        from (
            select
                mb.month_start,
                q.estimator_id as employee,
                p.name as project,
                max(p.total_sales_amount) as project_sales,
                max(p.gross_margin) as project_margin
            from `tabQuotation` q
            inner join `tabProject` p on p.name = q.project
            inner join mb on p.project_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
            where q.docstatus = 1
              and p.status = 'Completed'
              and q.estimator_id is not null and q.estimator_id != ''
              and p.project_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
            group by mb.month_start, q.estimator_id, p.name
        ) x
        group by month_start, employee
),
est_approvals as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            q.estimator_id as employee,
            count(*) as total_estimate_count,
            sum(case when coalesce(a.sales_order_count, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as total_approved_estimate_count
        from `tabQuotation` q
        inner join mb on q.transaction_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        left join (
            select soi.quotation, count(distinct so.name) as sales_order_count
            from `tabSales Order Item` soi
            inner join `tabSales Order` so on so.name = soi.parent
            where so.docstatus = 1 and coalesce(soi.quotation, '') != ''
            group by soi.quotation
        ) a on a.quotation = q.name
        where q.docstatus = 1
          and q.estimator_id is not null and q.estimator_id != ''
          and q.transaction_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        group by mb.month_start, q.estimator_id
),
bse_emps as (
        select emp.name as employee, emp.employee_name, emp.company,
            emp.vehicle_workshop, emp.vehicle_workshop_division
        from emp_info emp
        inner join bse_desig d on d.designation = emp.designation
        where emp.status = 'Active' and emp.vehicle_workshop_division = 'Body Shop'
),
bse_rows as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            e.*,
            coalesce(i.total_sales_amount, 0) as total_sales_amount,
            coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) as target_revenue,
            case when coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) <> 0
                 then round(coalesce(i.total_sales_amount, 0) / t.target_amount * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as revenue_percentage,
            case when coalesce(g.gp_sales, 0) <> 0
                 then round(g.gp_margin / g.gp_sales * 100, 3) else 0 end as gross_margin_percentage,
            case when coalesce(ap.total_estimate_count, 0) <> 0
                 then round(ap.total_approved_estimate_count / ap.total_estimate_count * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as estimate_to_approval_ratio
        from bse_emps e
        cross join mb
        left join est_invoiced i on i.month_start = mb.month_start and i.employee = e.employee
        left join est_gross_profit g on g.month_start = mb.month_start and g.employee = e.employee
        left join est_approvals ap on ap.month_start = mb.month_start and ap.employee = e.employee
        left join targets t on t.month_start = mb.month_start and t.employee = e.employee
            and t.designation in (select designation from bse_desig)
),
ibd_emps as (
        select emp.name as employee, emp.employee_name, emp.company,
            emp.vehicle_workshop, emp.vehicle_workshop_division
        from emp_info emp
        inner join ibd_desig d on d.designation = emp.designation
        where emp.status = 'Active'
),
ps_settings as (
        select
            max(case when field = 'materials_item_group' then value end) as materials_group,
            max(case when field = 'paint_item_group' then value end) as paint_group
        from `tabSingles`
        where doctype = 'Projects Settings'
),
mix_group_flags as (
        select
            c.name as item_group,
            max(case when r.role = 'labour' then 1 else 0 end) as in_labour,
            max(case when r.role = 'parts' then 1 else 0 end) as in_parts
        from `tabItem Group` c
        inner join (
            select 'labour' as role, 'Lumpsum Labour' as root
            union all select 'labour', 'AutoCare Services'
            union all select 'parts', materials_group from ps_settings
            union all select 'parts', paint_group from ps_settings
        ) r on r.root is not null and r.root != ''
        inner join `tabItem Group` rg on rg.name = r.root and c.lft >= rg.lft and c.rgt <= rg.rgt
        group by c.name
),
ibd_mix as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            q.estimator_id as employee,
            sum(sii.base_net_amount) as lp_total,
            sum(case when coalesce(sii.uom, '') = 'Hour' or coalesce(sii.stock_uom, '') = 'Hour'
                       or coalesce(g.in_labour, 0) = 1
                     then sii.base_net_amount else 0 end) as labour_amount
        from `tabQuotation` q
        inner join `tabProject` p on p.name = q.project
        inner join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.project = p.name
        inner join `tabSales Invoice Item` sii on sii.parent = si.name
        left join mix_group_flags g on g.item_group = sii.item_group
        inner join mb on si.posting_date between mb.month_start and mb.month_end
        where si.docstatus = 1 and q.docstatus = 1
          and q.estimator_id is not null and q.estimator_id != ''
          and si.posting_date >= ((curdate() - interval (day(curdate()) - 1) day) - interval 11 month)
        group by mb.month_start, q.estimator_id
),
ibd_rows as (
        select
            mb.month_start,
            e.*,
            coalesce(i.total_sales_amount, 0) as total_sales_amount,
            coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) as target_revenue,
            case when coalesce(t.target_amount, 0) <> 0
                 then round(coalesce(i.total_sales_amount, 0) / t.target_amount * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as revenue_percentage,
            case when coalesce(g.gp_sales, 0) <> 0
                 then round(g.gp_margin / g.gp_sales * 100, 3) else 0 end as gross_margin_percentage,
            case when coalesce(m.lp_total, 0) <> 0
                 then round(m.labour_amount / m.lp_total * 100, 3)
                 else 0 end as labour_perc_of_total_sales
        from ibd_emps e
        cross join mb
        left join est_invoiced i on i.month_start = mb.month_start and i.employee = e.employee
        left join est_gross_profit g on g.month_start = mb.month_start and g.employee = e.employee
        left join ibd_mix m on m.month_start = mb.month_start and m.employee = e.employee
        left join targets t on t.month_start = mb.month_start and t.employee = e.employee
            and t.designation in (select designation from ibd_desig)
)
